question: Before the stated completion date of '12 months after permit effective date' for cyanide effluent limitations, are the referenced Cyanide effluent limitations enforceable numeric discharge limits against which reported measurements must be compared, or does Section B item 1 defer numeric enforceability until that date?
semantic_arguments: Section B item 1 requires achieving compliance with Cyanide effluent limitations on a schedule whose completion date is '12 months after permit effective date'.
Purpose A requires distinguishing enforceable numeric limits from monitoring without an applicable numeric compliance comparison.
Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30) may include periods before and after that completion date depending on the permit effective date.
The passage references Cyanide effluent limitations but the target spans do not include the numeric limit values themselves.
notes: Section B frames cyanide obligations as a compliance schedule with a future completion date; Purpose A must decide whether interim periods within FY2025 still carry enforceable numeric limits or only schedule/reporting obligations until that date.
